newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cementos de Chihuahua rated sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cementos de Chihuahua rated sell.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais said it initiated coverage of Grupo Cementos de Chihuahua with a "sell" rating.

-- It said that despite a favorable operating environment, potential increased anti-dumping duties on GCC's exports, to 107 percent from 61.8 percent, would hurt the company's cash flow and earnings over the next two years.
-- It said it saw GCC shares as expensive and that upside for the stock was lower than for the market in general and the cement sector in particular
